d: Our recruiting team is a core strategic driver of OKX's success. We build the foundation of our future by hiring extraordinary talent who share our mission of building an inclusive future of finance. We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to partner with our core business teams as we expand our footprint across EMEA and globally.

In this role, you will act as a strategic talent partner and operational leader—building and cultivating executive and specialized talent pipelines, navigating nuanced regional markets, and optimizing end-to-end recruitment delivery. You will have the opportunity to architect hiring processes from scratch, drive proactive sourcing strategies prioritizing diversity, and help shape the next evolution of OKX. This role reports to the Head of Talent Acquisition.
q: Deep familiarity with EMEA fintech, traditional banking, and digital asset/Web3 ecosystems.
Working knowledge of regional regulatory environments affecting financial talent hiring (e.g., MiCA, AML frameworks, PSD2/PSD3, FCA, BaFin, DASP).
Experience recruiting within a globally distributed, multilingual organization.
Genuine interest or personal background in blockchain technology, crypto, and decentralized finance.
r: Strategic Talent Leadership: Define, design, and lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies across corporate governance, legal, compliance, risk, and operational business functions as organizational priorities scale.
Proactive Sourcing & Pipeline Architecture: Build and execute targeted sourcing campaigns to engage and close high-caliber passive talent across global and EMEA talent hubs.

Regional Market Navigation: Navigate complex EMEA hiring dynamics, proactively managing regional notice periods, candidate expectations, and competitive talent pools to maintain velocity and operational efficiency.

Talent Intelligence & Advisory: Conduct competitor mapping and gather market intelligence across fintech, traditional banking, and crypto to advise leadership on talent trends, salary benchmarks, and organizational design.
Employer Value Proposition: Articulate OKX’s vision to bridge traditional corporate and financial services talent into Web3 and decentralized finance.

Complex Negotiations & Closing: Direct senior-level offer formulations, equity/token incentive structuring, and complex negotiations, partnering closely with People Operations for seamless onboarding.

Hiring Manager Coaching & Governance: Act as an expert advisor, upskilling hiring managers and interview panels on structured assessment frameworks, interview best practices, and high-touch candidate experience.
What We Look For In You

Experience: 6+ years of full-lifecycle talent acquisition experience within a fast-paced corporate environment, high-growth fintech/financial services firm, or executive search firm, with demonstrated experience leading strategic hiring initiatives.
Sourcing & Closing: Proven track record of identifying, engaging, and closing senior passive talent across competitive finance, banking, or fintech ecosystems.

EMEA Labor Knowledge: In-depth understanding of cross-border EMEA hiring practices, regional employment regulations, statutory notice periods, and hiring frameworks (FTE vs. contractor, local entities vs. EOR).
Strategic Influence & Data Fluency: Strong business acumen with hands-on experience leveraging recruitment metrics, funnel analytics, and market intelligence to guide executive decision-making.
Agility & Ownership: High degree of comfort operating in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments with changing business priorities.
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional consultative communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills.

d: Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

The British School of Bahrain (BSB) is a multi-award-winning school and one of the top international schools in Bahrain, educating children with demonstrable success for over 30 years. The school is rated “Outstanding” by Bahrain Quality Assurance (BQA) and British School Overseas (BSO).

The British School of Bahrain is renowned for offering the best holistic UK-based education within Bahrain. BSB’s core values of Excellence, Responsibility & Individuality underpin everything that we do and are epitomised by our three pillars of Academics, Sports and the Arts.

BSB delivers high-quality British education to around 2,600 students aged 3 to 18 years and employs 306 full-time staff representing 31 different countries who are carefully handpicked. BSB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check/ICPC or equivalent and satisfactory pre-employment references.

BSB is a vibrant and enjoyable place to work, and is renowned for its pedagogy, staff development and academic success. The value we place on individuality is evident in our inclusive and innovative teaching approach. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, with some adaptations to the local context and offers IGCSE, BTEC and A-Level examinations. Our aim is to provide our graduating students with a passport to the best universities, colleges and careers around the world.
We are seeking to appoint a Teacher of Humanities to start in April, 2027 to provide maternity cover for 1 year.

r: Creating Engaging Lessons: Plan and deliver lessons that inspire and challenge all students and are in line with the school's curriculum, policies, and external assessment requirements.
